review_marker.provenance: specified: first line the review.yml prompt requires of the model; the extractor refuses a reply that does not start with it (PR #67)

bot_login.provenance: specified: the login GitHub gives a comment posted with the workflow GITHUB_TOKEN; chosen by the operator as the only author the mirror trusts, 2026-10-16

pr_marker_template.provenance: chosen by the operator 2026-10-16: hidden first line that lets a re-run find and update its own PR comment instead of posting another

issue_marker_template.provenance: chosen by the operator 2026-10-16: hidden first line of the Issue copy, same purpose as pr_marker_template

allowed_tools.provenance: specified: PR #67 review round 1 H1 and code review round 1 - the only tools the model session may have next to ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. An ALLOWLIST, so a tool nobody thought to forbid (WebFetch, Monitor, PowerShell, an MCP tool) is refused. Must equal the --tools list of review.yml, which a test asserts

author_pattern.provenance: specified: GitHub username rule (alphanumeric and single hyphens, at most 39 characters); anything else is refused before it can carry a mention or a newline

secret_patterns.provenance: specified: public token formats of the Anthropic API key and of GitHub tokens, the two secrets this workflow handles; chosen by the operator 2026-10-16 as defence in depth, since the reply is posted publicly

comment_max_chars.provenance: specified: GitHub rejects an issue or pull request comment above 65536 characters; 60000 is a margin chosen by the operator 2026-10-16, not measured, so the sanitiser's expansion and the header cannot tip a long review over the limit

pr_pattern.provenance: specified: a pull request number is a positive integer; nine digits is a margin chosen by the operator 2026-10-16, far above any real repository, applied with a full match

comment_id_pattern.provenance: specified: GitHub comment ids are positive integers that keep growing (ten digits in 2026); fifteen is a margin chosen by the operator 2026-10-16, applied with a full match

sha_pattern.provenance: specified: a full git commit SHA-1 is forty lowercase hexadecimal characters, applied with a full match

gh_retry_delay_seconds.provenance: chosen by the operator 2026-10-16, not measured: pause between two attempts of a read that failed with a transient error (R10)

gh_timeout_seconds.provenance: chosen by the operator 2026-10-16, not measured: bound on one gh call (R10)

gh_retries.provenance: chosen by the operator 2026-10-16, not measured: extra attempts after a failed gh call (R10)
